title: Redis: restore from a backup
description: Restores a prior `backup take` snapshot. DESTRUCTIVE: overwrites existing cluster data. scp's the per-shard .rdb back, stops redis-server, replaces dump.rdb, restarts. Live-verified 2026-06-05.

observe.what: backup id confirmed · items restored (sum of keys across shards) · duration
key count matches the backup state

whatProves: Round-trip backup -> destroy data -> restore -> verify keys returned works end-to-end.
